summary: Tested Video Library (Biblioteca de Vídeos) feature. All backend API endpoints and frontend UI functionality working correctly. Feature allows users to view, refresh, and add previously generated HeyGen videos to slides.
passed_tests: ✅ Backend API GET /api/heygen/videos returns list of videos with all required fields
✅ Backend API GET /api/heygen/videos/{video_id}/refresh updates and returns video status
✅ Videos sorted by creation date (newest first)
✅ Video data includes: video_id, title, status, video_url, thumbnail_url, duration, script, created_at
✅ Video Library button (Film icon) visible in editor toolbar with data-testid='video-library-btn'
✅ Dialog opens with title '📹 Biblioteca de Vídeos'
✅ Each video displays: thumbnail, title, status badge, date/time, duration, script preview
✅ Status badges: 'Concluído' (green) for completed, 'Processando' (yellow) for processing
✅ Completed videos show 'Adicionar' button to add to slide
✅ Processing videos show 'Atualizar' button to refresh status
✅ 'Atualizar Lista' button refreshes entire video list
✅ Clicking 'Adicionar' adds video to current slide with success toast
✅ Clicking 'Atualizar' refreshes individual video status with toast feedback
✅ Video preview appears on hover for completed videos

GET /api/heygen/videos.returns: { videos: [{ video_id, title, status, video_url, thumbnail_url, duration, script, avatar_id, voice_id, project_id, transparent, created_at }] }
GET /api/heygen/videos.notes: Supports optional ?project_id filter, sorted by created_at descending

GET /api/heygen/videos/{video_id}/refres.returns: { video_id, status, video_url, thumbnail_url, duration, title, script, project_id, created_at }
GET /api/heygen/videos/{video_id}/refres.notes: Calls HeyGen API to get latest status and updates database
